ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The food web in the picture includes organisms such as Algae and floating plants, Aquatic crustaceans, Fish, Minnows, Ducks and Raccoons. You can see an arrow from “Aquatic crustaceans” pointing to “Fish,” with the arrow tip at Fish. Then reason: In a food web, arrows indicate energy being transferred from the organism being eaten to the predator or consumer. Therefore, a decrease in the number of aquatic crustaceans will most directly reduce the available energy of Fish that feed on them and obtain energy from them.
